rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a seven-day period.

example.english: I’ll only be free next week.
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 sin1 dak1 haan4

rows.note: Use this colloquial alternative for the same seven-day period.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
